# @kayjs/live Reference

> Zero-dependency typed Server-Sent Events (SSE) rooms, microtask-coalesced broadcasts, connection caps, backpressure handling, and a reactive `useLive()` browser hook.

## Imports

- `@kayjs/live`: `createRooms`; types `Rooms`, `RoomsOptions`, `RoomsEndpointOptions`, `StreamOptions`, `Subscriber`, `ConnectionLimits`, `LiveAuthorizeHook`.
- `@kayjs/live/client`: `useLive`; types `LiveConnection`, `LiveStatus`, `UseLiveOptions`.

## Server Setup (`createRooms<TMessage, TMember>(options?)`)

`createRooms()` returns a single object that is both the `KayPlugin` (register in `kay.config.ts` so streams close on `api.onShutdown()`) and the handle routes/actions publish with:

- Mounted endpoint mode (`path` set): mounts `GET <path>` as `text/event-stream`.
  - `path`: route path (e.g. `'/api/events'`).
  - `room`: room name or `(ctx: RequestContext) => string` (default `'default'`).
  - `member`: `(ctx: RequestContext) => TMember | Promise<TMember>` (required when `path` is set).
  - `authorize`: `(ctx, room) => boolean | Response | Promise<boolean | Response>` (`false` → `403`).
  - `pingMs`: keepalive interval in ms (default `20000`, `0` disables).
  - `onJoin(room, member)`, `onLeave(room, member)`.
- Manual route mode (omit `path`): no route mounted; return `rooms.stream(ctx, { room, member, pingMs?, onJoin?, onLeave?, ...limits })` from a `GET` route handler.
- `ConnectionLimits`: `maxConnectionsPerRoom` (`1000`), `maxConnectionsPerClient` (`10`, returns `429`), `maxTotalConnections` (`10000`, returns `503`), `clientKey(ctx)` (defaults to `ctx.ip`), `highWaterMark` (`64`).

## Handle Methods & Client Hook

- `rooms.publish(room, message, event?, id?)`: broadcasts JSON-serialized SSE frames to all room subscribers.
- `rooms.coalesce(build, event?)`: returns `(room) => void` that batches burst updates into one microtask broadcast per room.
- `rooms.members(room)`, `rooms.size(room)`, `rooms.stream(ctx, opts)`, `rooms.join(room, sub)`, `rooms.leave(room, sub)`.
- `useLive<TMessage>(url, onMessage?, options?)` (`@kayjs/live/client`): returns `{ status: Signal<'connecting' | 'open' | 'closed'>, last: Signal<TMessage | undefined>, close() }` with exponential-backoff reconnect (`baseDelayMs`, `maxDelayMs`, `jitterMs`, `events`, `withCredentials`) and automatic `onMount` cleanup.

## Snippets

```ts
// src/rooms.ts (and register `plugins: [chat]` in kay.config.ts)
import { createRooms } from '@kayjs/live'

export type ChatMsg = { from: string, text: string }
export const chat = createRooms<ChatMsg, { name: string }>({
  path: '/api/chat',
  room: ctx => ctx.url.searchParams.get('room') ?? 'general',
  member: ctx => ({ name: ctx.locals.user?.name ?? 'guest' }),
})
```

```tsx
// src/components/ChatFeed.tsx (auto-island)
import { signal } from '@kayjs/kay'
import { useLive } from '@kayjs/live/client'
import type { ChatMsg } from '../rooms'

export function ChatFeed({ room }: { room: string }) {
  const messages = signal<ChatMsg[]>([])
  const live = useLive<ChatMsg>(`/api/chat?room=${room}`, m => { messages.value = [...messages.value, m] })
  return <section data-status={live.status.value}>{messages.value.map((m, i) => <p key={i}>{m.from}: {m.text}</p>)}</section>
}
```
